name: switchtender-ui-e2e
description: Real-browser tests for the SwitchTender web UI, driven by Playwright. The smoke suite renders and navigates the seeded read-only demo; the interactive suite launches a run and creates objects against a writable serve instance and checks the change persisted. Together they complement the dependency-free node --test suite in ../assets/jstest, which drives the same production JS against a simulated DOM: that suite proves the logic and wiring, and these prove the pages render, click through, and mutate in a real browser engine.
